The separate StructureDefinition.description remains a shorter resource summary; the Jira related URL and applied commit target the generated ResearchStudy element definition, so changing that summary would be outside this issue's approved scope.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml already contains the exact approved wording at the ResearchStudy root definition, and no conflicting community or later decision evidence was found.
